initialization: Both arms start from same-seed sealed F10 rehearsal final parameters; reset Adam to zero; same frozen F7 fit_train supervision coefficient0.1 in both arms. No parameter/architecture/feature/reward change.
opponent_control: Both training arms face tactical-v1 exclusively, with alternating learner seats for official-start games. This isolates prefix-reset distribution from opponent identity. It is not a comparison against continuing F10 self-play.
curriculum: Use all65 sealed F11 train-only starts, sampled by its fixed family weights then uniformly within family across all bank seeds. Prefix actions never enter PPO/GAE or supervised targets. Resets keep original simulator chance state and public history; suffix actors use fresh per-episode keys. Natural terminal reward and explicit cutoff bootstrap are unchanged.
selection: Collect complete suffixes/fresh games in chunks8 separately until each selected-row quota is met; max128 games per stratum/update, fail without extension. Compute same-player GAE before uniform sampling without replacement within each stratum; shuffle the combined1024 rows. Prefix selected-row fractions102/1024,205/1024,256/1024 in three16-update stages; control0. Exact row mix replaces the F11 proposed episode-fraction mix. Report unequal games, prefix replay cost and excluded rows.
pairing: Shared fresh-game, actor and optimizer seed namespaces across arms; cursors and on-policy trajectories may diverge. Same new PPO row, Adam and rehearsal budgets; unequal simulator work. Prefix states are reused and development-informed, not held-out families.
gates: Primary per-seed curriculum benefit: tactical curriculum-minus-official cutoff-aware lower point gain>=0.05 and approximate familywise bootstrap lower>0, tactical curriculum-minus-initial lower point gain>=0.05 and bootstrap lower>0, no detected random/base_power regression versus initial or official, final curriculum cutoff rates<=0.05. All3 seeds required for overall pass. Preserve all27 arm/initial contrasts, Hoeffding bounds, terminal-only value diagnostics and full-battle error proxies; no conclusions from pooled wins alone.
diagnostics: On every development learner decision count heuristic disagreements, damage-choice flags, recovery/setup/status flags and full-HP Recover choices from the public-only F11 observer. These are descriptive and not alternative primary endpoints or ground-truth errors. Terminal-only critic MSE versus0.5 and same-cell post-hoc fitted constant remain descriptive.
verification: Reproduce all initial/final evaluation policy decisions/values and simulator outcomes; replay every training cohort/batch/update from registered initialization, checking stage checkpoints and original final update recovery. Retain unavailable feedback and all suffix/prefix counters. Freeze source/runtime, inputs, tests and plan before production.
interpretation: Small fixed development ablation after adaptive F11 audit; fresh official development teams/mechanics across endpoints, recurring train-only prefixes, known frozen opponents. Does not establish held-out opponent/family or public ladder generalization. Completion may coexist with failed or inconclusive benefit gate.
